name: announcement-bar
title: Announcement bar
description: A strip of kraft paper taped across the top of the page: a New ribbon, one sentence, a link and a dismiss button. Looks right on paper or on the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Announcement bar" block into your components directory under blocks/announcement-bar/.
Import it: import AnnouncementBarBlock from "<your components alias>/blocks/announcement-bar/page"
